title: WMS – Warehouse Management System
overview: WMS is a centralized Warehouse Management System built on the Appian Low-Code Platform to simplify inventory management, warehouse operations, order fulfilment, sales & lead management and AI Powered Insights. It provides a single workspace to manage stock, warehouse activities, shipments, sales, and workforce operations.

The platform replaces manual processes and disconnected systems with real-time dashboards, inventory tracking, warehouse heatmaps, and AI-powered operational insights. This helps organizations improve inventory accuracy, optimize warehouse operations, and deliver orders faster.
problemIntro: The client's warehouse operations relied on manual processes and disconnected systems, making inventory and fulfilment difficult to manage.

problems.title: Scattered Inventory Data
problems.desc: Stock information was spread across multiple systems.

problems.title: Limited Operational Visibility
problems.desc: Teams lacked a real-time view of inventory and warehouse activities.

problems.title: Manual Warehouse Processes
problems.desc: Inventory updates and shipment tracking were time-consuming.

problems.title: Poor Demand Planning
problems.desc: No predictive insights for stock shortages or fulfilment risks.

solution: We designed a centralized Warehouse Management System on the Appian Low-Code Platform to manage inventory, warehouse operations, shipments, sales, and workforce activities from a single platform.

The solution provides real-time dashboards, inventory management, warehouse heatmaps, fulfilment tracking, and AI-powered demand forecasting, enabling faster operations, better inventory control, and smarter business decisions.

modules.title: Executive Dashboard
modules.desc: Monitor warehouse KPIs, inventory, and fulfilment performance in real time.

modules.title: Inventory Management
modules.desc: Track stock levels, SKU availability, and low-stock alerts across warehouses.

modules.title: Warehouse Operations
modules.desc: Manage warehouse zones, storage capacity, equipment, and fulfilment activities.

modules.title: Sales & Lead Management
modules.desc: Track sales performance, customer leads, and regional business insights.

modules.title: Workforce Management
modules.desc: Manage employee attendance, payroll, recruitment, and warehouse staff.

modules.title: AI Powered Insights
modules.desc: Predict demand, identify stock risks, and optimize warehouse capacity using AI.

conclusion: WMS centralizes warehouse operations, inventory management, and fulfilment into a single platform. By combining automation, real-time visibility, and AI-powered insights, it enables organizations to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and scale logistics operations with confidence.

Values Delivered: ✓ Faster Order Fulfilment ✓ Centralized Inventory Visibility ✓ Improved Inventory Accuracy ✓ Reduced Manual Processes ✓ Better Warehouse Utilization ✓ AI-Powered Demand Forecasting ✓ Enhanced Team Productivity ✓ Scalable Warehouse Operations
